notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Today, we are announcing a big patch here.We made some changes and added new features. These are listed below.[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33808571/8b067555f453bfb21db68323c3e73dae230275f5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] The game was replaced by a third party camera from the first-person camera view. (You can change the angle with the middle mouse button.)
[*] Added new character.
[*] Added new military upper zone.
[*] Trees and rocks can now be cut with an ax.
[*] Added radar system to display animals and zombies on the mini map.
[*] Now you can make your home anywhere on the map. (Limit removed.)
[*] Errors in the art system have been fixed.
[*] The inventory section has been doubled.
[*] Changes were made to the factory area.
[*] You can climb to some places with stairs.
[*] Added new axe model.
Please feel free to report any errors you see to us. Performance updates will be made in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: All bugs fixed
notes.content:
[b]Dear survivors, thank you for purchasing our early access game.
Thanks to you, we fix the errors. You can let us know by opening a topic here.[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed food values.
[*] Fixed save progress.
[*] Fixed settings UI.
[*] Fixed build area.
[/list]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33808571/fd8f5ae98295dffacacb4b6b7e553987b7614638.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33808571/d9c499d48e9d7af11176925d63d5b99f763bf0d4.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Base Bilding system added.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33808571/fd8f5ae98295dffacacb4b6b7e553987b7614638.jpg[/img]
[b]Now you can build your own house by collecting wood rock and other building materials. Collect materials and protect them from external dangers.
[h1]What should I do to build?[/h1]
[list]
[*]* Find the ax and the trees.
[*]* Crush the rocks with the help of digging.
[*]* Get the nails with metal parts.
[/list]
